in_marathi.name: Nihalraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of the Night
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nihalraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Nihalraj is a compound name derived from Sanskrit. 'Nihal' means 'ruler' and 'Raj' means 'reign' or 'rule'. The name signifies a ruler or leader who governs over the night. It is a powerful and regal name for a baby boy in Hindu tradition.
